name: everything_count_stats
description:
Get count and size statistics for files matching a query.

Fast way to understand the scope of a query without listing every file.
Optionally breaks down by extension for a high-level overview.

query.description: Search query to count/measure.  Same syntax as everything_search. Examples: 'ext:py path:C:\Projects', 'ext:log size:>1mb', '*.tmp'
query.title: Query

include_size.description: Also calculate total size of all matching files
include_size.title: Include Size

breakdown_by_extension.description: Break down count and size by file extension (samples top 200 results)
breakdown_by_extension.title: Breakdown By Extension

name: everything_file_details
description:
Get detailed metadata and optional content preview for specific files.

Returns: full path, size, dates, type, permissions, hidden status.
For directories: item count, subdirectories, file listing.
For text files with preview_lines > 0: first N lines of content.

preview_lines.description: Lines of text content to preview (0 = none, max 200)
preview_lines.title: Preview Lines

name: everything_find_recent
description:
Find files modified within a recent time period.

Ideal for discovering what changed in a project, tracking recent
downloads, finding today's log files, etc.  Sorted newest-first.

period.description: How recent.  Options: 1min, 5min, 10min, 15min, 30min, 1hour, 2hours, 6hours, 12hours, today, yesterday, 1day, 3days, 1week, 2weeks, 1month, 3months, 6months, 1year.  Or raw Everything syntax like 'last2hours'.
period.title: Period

name: everything_search
description:
Search for files and folders instantly using voidtools Everything.

Leverages Everything's real-time NTFS index for sub-millisecond search
across all local and mapped drives.  Supports wildcards, regex, size/date
filters, extension filters, path restrictions, and content search.

query.description: Search query using Everything syntax. Examples: '*.py' (all Python files), 'ext:py;js path:C:\Projects' (Python/JS in Projects), 'size:>10mb ext:log' (large logs), 'dm:today ext:py' (Python files modified today), 'content:TODO ext:py' (files containing TODO - requires content indexing), '"exact phrase"' (exact filename match), 'regex:test_\d+\.py$' (regex). Combine with space (AND) or | (OR). Prefix ! to exclude.
query.title: Query

sort.description: Sort order. Options: date-created, date-created-asc, date-created-desc, date-modified, date-modified-asc, date-modified-desc, extension, name, name-desc, path, path-desc, size, size-asc, size-desc
sort.title: Sort

match_path.description: Match against full path, not just filename
match_path.title: Match Path

name: everything_search_by_type
description:
Search for files by type category.

Categories: audio, video, image, document, code, archive, executable,
font, 3d, data.  Each maps to a curated list of file extensions.

file_type.description: File type category: 3d, archive, audio, code, data, document, executable, font, image, video
file_type.title: File Type

query.description: Additional search filter (e.g. 'config' to narrow results)
query.title: Query
